nom: Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream

avis.texte: after about 2 weeks of using this eye cream I started being asked on a regular basis if I was tired or sick. and it irritates my eyes! total waste of money

This gel cream is lightweight and absorbs almost instantly. It is not very moisturizing, but does give a little hydration. Every time I use it, my lower eyelid twitches incessantly all day. I looked it up, and apparently niacinamide can cause eyelid twitching when used close to the eyes. I've used niacinamide on my face, but not near my eyes, so I've not had this issue before. I've only used this 3 days and it's happened every one of those days before I finally put it together that it's the eye cream causing it. Apparently it can take several days to resolve, but it should be okay.
After a month no improvement in der eye puffiness or dark circles. Waste of my money.

I really wanted to like this eye cream given the price point and great reviews. However, I find that this does not absorb well. I typically use it at night and then will wake up in the morning will little clumps around my eyes. Its gross and stringy! Will not be purchasing again :(

avis.titre: Not for all sensitive skin types
avis.texte: Unfortunately this did not work well for me. There's a burning sensation right after I apply it, it seems to make my dark circles worse, and caused bags which were not there previously. Not sure if I'm potentially sensitive to the niacinimide and that's causing the issue? Either way, I like that it's fragrance free, but it's just not for me.
This is very hydrating moisturizer. A little goes a long way. More hydrating than a lot of expensive brands. I highly recommend.

I'm grateful to have been sent this Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream for free in exchange for my review. I was impressed by the ingredients in this, so I was excited to try it. I really like the texture and it feels so nice on my skin, so it makes it easy to use it regularly.

This product is very moisturizing for the eye area. Doesn't go on sticky. It's a nice thick cream that absorbs well. You can wear it alone or with foundation. Helps the dark under eye circles. I recommend

avis.titre: Very hydrating! Works great under makeup
avis.texte: Being a content creator in my 40s, I've been on the hunt for a good under eye cream. When this product became available to review through the Home tester club I was thrilled that I was chosen to do just that! I had high expectations going into this and I can tell you that! It helps with my dark circles as well as smooth out and hydrates the under eye so that my concealer day lays down very nicely! Neutrogena is a brand that I know and trust. I expected nothing less! Again this did not disappoint. Highly recommend giving it a go if you have the opportunity to do so. Remember to lay down sunscreen because this is a college in based cream! Although I received this product as a try and review opportunity, I stand by my thoughts and opinions!

I love Neutrogena skincare products so I was excited to receive Neutrogena collagen bank reviving eye cream to try. I haven't been using eye cream as often as I should so I definitely have been noticing a need for one. This cream is a nice thick consistency, it applies well, absorbs well and I am already starting to notice results.

avis.titre: Keep your eye area looking great
avis.texte: This new Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream is a good eye product. This helps to keep your eye area looking great. It helps to preserve collagen, and get rid of those dark circles, fine lines , and puffiness. It absorbs quickly and can be used under your makeup.

I like that the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream absorbs quickly and moisturizes around the eyes. It also gives your eyes a refresh look. It has helped improve the puffiness around my eyes from being tired. I think this formula is perfect and doesn't need any improvement .

I truly love this cream. I found it absorbs well without leaving my eyes feeling greasy. The fact that it's unscented is also a great thing. No stinging and very hydrating. I would absolutely give this a try in your night routine.

I've been loving this Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream. I love the way it applies and it absorbs quickly, leaving my under eyes smooth and helping get rid of dark circles! I love that it has Collagen in it, I can tell that at "40 something" (lol), my under eye skin is not as firm and smooth as it used to be. Let's face it, nothing is going to give me the last 25-30 years back, but this does help with some of the issues that I have and that's good enough for me! I will continue to use this cream and I'm excited to see what the long term results look like!!

I really enjoyed using this product. Usually when I think of Eye Creams I think of them being thick and heavy, which is what most have been all this time. Not only is it rare to find a lightweight eye cream but then to find one that's a gel cream?! Only this past summer have I started really using Gel Creams instead of lotions and the difference is night and day. I have to say the same is true with this as well. I enjoyed the feel and texture of this so much! That's why I took a picture of it swatched on my arm, so you can get an idea of just how light it really is. And that's a lot! I don't know about anyone else, but I found that I barely needed any on each eye. A little goes a long way. I definitely want to try it for longer but during the time I used it I did notice an improvement in my dark circles. This is definitely a great product and has me wanting to try Neutrogena's Gel Cream for my face as well!

I love that this eye gel cream has collagen in it. Also love the fact that it's a gel, makes it feel spa-like applying it and the feel of it feels soothing. It will help treat fine lines, dark circles, and under eye puffiness. I apply every morning and night and have noticed a big difference in the tone and texture under my eyes. This will be a must for my daily routine. I received this in exchange for my honest feedback after testing. I'm in love. #hometesterclub #neutrogena

avis.titre: Visible results in a short time
avis.texte: I've been using collagen eye cream for two weeks. I really like that this feels more like a serum than a lotion. It absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving any greasiness, which I really appreciate. There's no scent at all, either in the jar or once applied. l've noticed a visible improvement in the dark areas in the corners of my eyes. It's definitely not as dark as it used to be. I've also been starting to get small bags under my eyes and this has helped to start to reduce them. It's seems to be firming that area up. Overall, very happy with the results I'm seeing in such a short time.

This is my most favorite eye gel cream ever! I had tried so many products and none of them worked like this one does. I am truly a forever customer! It's not sticky, it meets right into your skin. It's honestly incredible!

This is a gel formula and has a nice consistency that absorbed well into my skin. It was easy to get out of the container. It left my eye area hydrated, smooth, & radiant. I didnt have any issues applying my make up on top, it gave me a nice base to work on. I also like that it doesn't have a fragrance. Ive only been using it for a little over a week but my favorite things so far is the consistency, leaves my skin smooth, and how it brightens my eye area.
I like how this went on some smoothly, as a light gel. I used it at night and it has no overpowering scent. I have noticed an improvement in my dark circles and sunken-looking eyes for sure.

I sampled this product for a few weeks and I absolutely loved it! My eye area felt amazing after using this. It worked well under my makeup and my eyes looked great. Such a great product for the price point!

Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream felt like it worked great on my eyes. My face absorbed the gel pretty quickly. I did feel like some Irritation when I put some around the top of my eyes so I stop doing that and only put some on the corners of my eyes and that seemed to help with any eye irritation. I do feel as if it's working great so far. I will continue to use it.

Neutrogena's latest eye cream, Collagen bank reviving eye cream is so refreshing and very different than any other I have tried! I look forward to applying this product every morning and night because it feels SO cool and refreshing! The texture and feel of the cream is very premium. It doesn't just melt off my skin like most do. In only 7 days I can tell my eyes look less tired and the dark circles have faded some! Neutrogena has once again made premium skincare accessible to everyday gals like me!

Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream works great! This amazing eye cream is clinically proven to visibly improve fine lines, brightness, dark circles, skin texture and skin tone. Nice to be gentle for daily use and sensitive skin. Love the ability to layer under makeup. Highly recommend!
I was gifted this Neutrogena collagen bank eye cream/gel in exchange for a honest review. I really like this eye cream/gel because it actually does not burn your eye when applying.

I would definitely recommend the Neutrogena collagen Bank eye cream. I was a little hesitant at first because it's more like a gel that a cream because I'm not a fan of gel like products on my face,But I really like this product. My expectations for it actually working was not very high.I was definitely wrong after only 3 days of using this product I couldnt see the dark circles under my eyes. Now I've been using this for almost 2 weeks I can actually feel a difference around my eye area like it's getting tighter. So if haven't tried the Neutrogena collegan bank products you definitely are missing out.

I've been using this product for over a week now and I really do enjoy using it and I've noticed some improvements. The texture of the product is very nice and easy to apply. You don't need a lot of it either. I have noticed some good results as well! I would recommend!

Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream works very well for improving the dark circles and fine lines under my eyes. I love the gel formula of this eye cream. It absorbs quickly into my skin, with no residue, while leaving the skin around my eye area feeling soft and with visible improvements. Excellent eye cream!

I recieved a free sample of this Neutrogena Collagen Eye Cream from pinchme. I really loved how this cream was light but still felt thick enough to really sit and work on the eyes throughout the day. I highly recommend this product.

I loved the texture and feeling of this product. It was very smooth and not too liquid-y. It spread very nicely around the eye area and didn't migrate. I have not noticed any effects from the product yet but it has only been two weeks.
Loved it it made my face feel so much better after I applied it I put it on every day after the shower and I instantly see my dark circles and my wrinkles disappear I absolutely love this product

I was very thrilled to try the Neutrogena Bank eye gel cream. I have wrinkles and dark spots and crows feet and need a good eye cream. Well I have found one the Neutrogena bank eye cream was a miracle in a jar. This cream made my skin soft and smooth and I seen less wrinkles and less darkness under eyes and my make up look better on eyes. There was no scent and no burning or irritation so I will repurchase when I need more eye cream and will be tell all my friends and family to try this gel cream.

Neutrogena has knocked it out of the park again! I love how they continously create products that actually work for women's skin and eyes. This one is the latest. Packed with good-for-your-eyes ingredients like Niacinamide, Hydrolyzed Collagen, Fruit Acids, and more, this lightweight cream packs a punch! The texture is ultra-smooth and feels luxurious on delicate eye areas. Used consistently, over time, dull, deprived peepers will show less under eye darkening, fewer lines, and improved tone and texture. You can take this one to the bank!

I have tried a lot of products and lately, Neutrogena has been hitting it out of the park with this line of products. The retinol face cream is amazing and now this eye cream has left me looking awake with less bags and more youthful eyes. I really like it.

I received the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream around two weeks ago and packaging was good, but the important thing about a product is does it help or work on your eyes? I would say the product feels very nice under your eyes and around eyes. I feel the product needs used for a longer period to truly know if it works, but I am sure the brands name stands good for their self! I love the feel of cream and keep in refrigerator as I think it feels refreshing for your eyes to keep your eye cream inside! I think the cream is going to change your life as the cream isn't as expensive as some other products already on the market, and I feel the cream will boost your confidence and make you feel great about your face!

Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream is five stars for me. Being that the cream is gel, it applies so smoothly, so evenly, and absorbs quickly. I smoked for many years and am 50, so I battle with the reality of the fine lines/laugh lines. The product works well for minimizing and smoothing out the appearance of them. And after the product is applied, it absorbs quickly and I am able to carry on with makeup during the day, and a thicker application at night. One of the best things about the eye cream gel is that it is thick, so the ingredients are not watered down. While I don't have sensitive skin, I appreciate that it has no discernable scent.

I like how soft this product feels, with consistent usage I notice my eye area does look improved with dark circles. I feel like it takes a bigger than average dollop of product for my skin to feel most hydrated. It absorbs quickly and smells nice.

avis.titre: Warmth and Hydration, But Is It Enough?
avis.texte: I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream for 20 days, applying it twice daily, in the morning and at night, as part of my skincare routine. One of the first things I noticed upon applying this cream is a gentle warming sensation in the eye area, which appeared a few seconds after application.During the trial period, I definitely felt increased hydration in my eye area. However, beyond this feeling of hydration, I haven't observed any other visible differences in the appearance of my eye area. I haven't noticed improvements in the reduction of dark circles, diminished fine lines, or any other benefits. I believe that to properly assess the effectiveness of an eye cream, a longer period of use is required. A timeframe of less than a month, as provided by Home Tester Club, may not be sufficient to observe significant visual results.

I have used the product for over a week and like that its goes on very smoothly. Its light and blends well with my finger. No sponges or tools. I have seen a difference in the fine lines that appeared and now they are not so relevant.

I love this product! It goes on so smoothly. The texture is amazing! I love the packaging. It's such a sleek little container. I used this product for 7 days straight and I can see such a visible difference. My eyes look visibly brighter and less tired constantly. It also helps hydrate the area around my under eyes which always seems dry in the summer months. I highly recommend this product and will be using this in my skin care routine from now on!

I have dark circles under my eyes. This eye gel cream helped revive my tired eyes. My under eye area felt moisturized and improved my puffiness. Lightly sticky feel to the texture of the eye gel cream. I recommend using it daily as part of your morning and nightly skin routine. This cream is better than other eye creams I've used.

After using this product for a week I have noticed significant boost in hydration around my eyes. I love the smooth, silicone feel of the product as it glides on smooth, absorbs nicely and makeup blends flawlessly. My only con is I haven't noticed a lightening of the dark circles but I didn't expect a miracle. Overall I love this product and will continue using it.
It works very well. It feels great on my skin and definitely helps lessen the puffiness and dark circles under my eyes. I would recommend it to friends and family members.

This new Neutrogena collagen Bank reviving eye gel cream has worked amazing. There's no scents or atrocious fragrance, and goes on smooth and dries fast. After using for just a week I had noticeable results and plan to continue using. With noticeably less puffiness and shadows it has definitely helped my routine. Would definitely recommend and plan to purchase again in the future.

I have enjoyed the eye cream a lot. It's more like a gel. It's very hydrating and smooth on your eyes. I haven't noticed a huge difference in my under eye but I feel with more use it will be beneficial.

I love Neutrogena products. This amazing eye cream is helping my fine lines around my eyes and also the sagging and dark circles. I haven't been using it long but in a short time I can see an improvement. I am so excited about this eye moisturizer, I have fought dark circles all my life and using this product is making a difference.

I have been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream for a couple of weeks now. It feels really good on my skin. I use day and night. It doesn't leave any residue on my skin. I haven't really noticed any changes since I've been using it. But it does feel good on.

I used this Neutrogena Collagen Reviving Eye Gel Cream for 11 days. I followed the directions on the box. I cleansed, treated with the serum, and moisturized. I did not use spf but it is recommended. I applied it in the morning and then in the evening. I used a very small amount around my eye area. I had zero irritation and it felt soothing. Within a couple of days I noticed less puffiness. Now I can see my dark circles getting lighter and less lines. I just feel like my eye area looks better. I look forward to seeing how much improvement I see over time. I was impressed by this product. (I don't have makeup on in either picture.)
I was pleasantly surprised by this Neutrogena eye cream product. It goes on smoothly and it's not sticky. I like the texture and it's also not greasy. I will be repurchasing.
After using this eye gel for the last couple of weeks I have noticed more elasticity and lighter skin under my eyes. The results so far are nice, I will continue to use for more benefits!

I've been using this for about 2 weeks now and I love it. You only need a dab so this little jar will last you for a long time. I had some puffiness and dark circles. I also have some little wrinkles forming under my eye. What I really like is that it's so soothing and refreshing. I live in Az, so, trust me, this gel is exactly what my thirsty eyes need.

This is really light for an eye cream. I prefer something a bit more moisturizing. This has a silicone like slippy feeling that I don't really like in an eye cream. I don't think it provides a lot of moisture and I feel like it sort of sits on top of the skin. It also doesn't play nicely with concealer. It's fine for night but there are more nourishing creams that I prefer. It also has niacinamide which caused a bit of irritation since I am sensitive to it.

I've been using this eye cream daily for about a week, and I'm really impressed with how much smoother and more hydrated my under eye area looks. The texture is light and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, which I love. It layers well under makeup and feels refreshing when applied. I haven't noticed a big change in fine lines yet, but I'm hopeful with continued use. Took off one star because I wish the results were a little faster on deeper wrinkles, but overall, this is a solid product that feels luxurious and effective!

First I want to start off by saying I recommend putting this eye cream in the fridge. It's a fantastic gel consistency and the cooling from being in the fridge helps with puffiness. Secondly this is super hydrating and a little goes a long way. With it being a gel it has more a slick texture vs a cream which soaks into the skin quicker. What's nice about the gel is that is instantly hydrates while also continuing hydrate throughout the day/night. Third it works well under concealer. I recommend letting it dry for about 5 minutes before going in with your makeup routine but my concealer stayed on perfectly and smoothly throughout a 12 hour day. Fourth it does help with finer lines and minor puffiness.

avis.titre: The holy grail of eye creams!!
avis.texte: Im so glad I recieved this product as I suffer from dark circles, fine lines and puffiness that's hereditary. First off the texture of this is like a very light watery gel that glides so smoothly under your eyes. Second, it sinks into your skin immediately and it instantly feels hydrated and cool. I noticed a difference in my first use but after a week of using the product I noticed my puffiness and dark circles drastically reduced! There's not many products I can say this about. I will be repurchasing.

This is a great moisturizer. The smell is fairly faint and not overwhelming. It is too soon to see long term benefits, but ai believe this would be especially good for dry skin or during winter months. Im not sure effectiveness for the price though

This stuff is great. I've noticed more softened fine lines. Less eye baggage. More moisturized skin around the eye. It's not greasy. Melts into my skin almost instantly. No irritation, redness or breakouts.

Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream Is heaven sent I swear. With this product I have reduced my puffiness and my dark circles have vanished. It goes on lightweight and leaves my skin feeling and looking smooth. I love this stuff!

I love Neutrogena products and use many things from their various lines but this was the first time I'd tried an eye cream. It's great for summer heat, it's a lightweight gel that instantly pumps your undereye area, I could see it fill in some tiny lines. My only complaint is it leaves a sort of shiny residue around your eye for a little while, you can reduce it by patting it for awhile longer but it doesn't absorb as fast as I wish it did. Other than that it's fantastic, definitely recommend for a summer daytime eye cream!

I am in my late 30s and I have a constantly tired look and fine lines around my eyes. This cream does wake my eyes up and it gives them a younger look. My morning puffiness also disappeares in no time.

I like this 5 in 1 cream! It improved my puffy under eyes. I also liked the way it moisturize and refreshed feeling it gave me. Also it worked well with my sunscreen it didn't cake up or had a messy feeling!

I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream for just over a week now, and I'm honestly impressed. The skin under my eyes feels noticeably smoother and more hydrated. I struggle with puffiness and dark circles (especially in the mornings), and I've seen a visible improvement in both. The cream itself has a light, cooling texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. It works really well under makeup too, which is a huge plus. I've been pairing it with sunscreen during the day as recommended, and so far, no irritation at all, even with my somewhat sensitive skin. Overall, this eye cream has earned a spot in my daily routine. I'm looking forward to seeing continued improvements the longer I use it. Definitely recommend giving it a try if you're dealing with tired-looking eyes or early signs of aging!
If you're looking for something new and that works then look no further than Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream! I was and still am very happy with how my under eye skin looks.

I was so excited when i received this free sample of Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream. I have seen it in the stores, but I never tried it before until now. It definitely took away the fine lines and crows feet around my eyes and left my skin looking smoother and tighter than before i started this product. On my 50th birthday, i received lots of compliments on how well my skin looked which made me super excited to be the BIG 50 i guess, lol.
You can't go wrong with Neutrogena Collagen Reviving Eye cream! Leaves your eyes super moisturized and I see signs of improvement on my under eye fine lines. Highly recommend!!

I thought it was just wonderful. You can feel the moisture under eyes and almost immediately can notice the difference under your eyes. It's a great and easy routine to add to your beauty routine throughout the day.

I tried this product every morning and every night for seven days and ongoing. I think that this product really works. I was really happy with the results and in my opinion it sure is 100% a collagen Bank reviving eye gel cream just like it says. I would recommend it to my friends and family and whomever else that I could I will continue to use it and most likely purchase more of it in the future..

The cream is very soft and glides on without being sticky. I used this in the mornings and noticed it took away my puffiness. It's very hydrating. I didn't notice a huge difference in the fine lines and wrinkles, but I will keep trying it to see if I notice a difference.
I love this gel it's made a huge difference in my eye bags and it's a staple in my everyday face care routine . I will definitely be buying again and as needed
Absolutely love this product. Light, airy and no visible fragrance. Absorbs quickly and leaves behind a smooth, hydrated and cool feeling.

Overall, I like Neutrogena's Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream. It has a nice consistency and feels good on the skin. It blends in quickly and isn't irritating. I do feel that I have seen some improvements in the area around my eyes. My skin seems to look healthier and brighter since I've started using this, and I've only been using this at night, though it does state it can be used both morning and night. I think there is some improvement in the fine lines around my eyes too. I would certainly consider buying this again and would recommend it.

I've been using this eye cream for a little over a week, and so far, it's been a nice addition to my routine. The texture is light, cooling, and absorbs quickly—perfect for morning and night. I love that it's fragrance-free and gentle on my skin. In terms of results, I noticed some mild hydration and a slightly smoother texture around my eyes. However, I didn't see major changes in puffiness or dark circles. It's a nice, non-irritating option for basic eye care and hydration, but if you're looking for dramatic anti-aging results or visible brightening, this may not be strong enough on its own.

This Neutrogena collagen Bank Reviving eye gel cream really feels good when applied to my eyes. After a week I started feeling and seeing a difference in the puffiness around my eyes I would definitely recommend this product.

avis.titre: Nitrogen's collagen bank reviving eye cr
avis.texte: I really love this item. It has helped with skin around eyes being supple and helps diminish the look of wrinkles or dark under eye areas. I love the results and that it has very little smell. I like neutrogena a lot. One of my favorites. This is a must have. I will definitely continue using this and keep some handy.

avis.titre: Collagen, where have been my adult life?
avis.texte: I could tell from the first day that I use this collagen from Neutrogena that my eyes seriously needed this and it was going to improve them quickly. Over the period of 7 days I used this product twice a day and notice significant firming and elasticity in my under eye. I will definitely continue using this product even after it's pretty sample is gone. I really and please with the way that it makes me look and the way it's translating makes me feel. I will recommend this product and already have to my family and friends and I will be buying some very soon.

I truly wanted the best from this product. Was so hopeful it would depuff, lighten dark circles, and generally give me a youthful "glow" in my delicate eye area, alas, I can't fully say it did. Despite the fact that it indeed feels great going on as it is nice a creamy and glides on well, it could not be worn under makeup because it made the concealer produce little "crumbles" under the eye and it just didn't look smooth.
This ice cream is wonderful! I love the gel part of it. It is lightweight and has a light scent. Neutro has always been a brand I could count on for making a quality product.

This eye cream does wonders for me. Usually I have dark circles under my eyes, sometimes puffiness. This cream visibly reduced both those issues. My skin under my eyes looked smooth and soft after using this cream. I will definitely be looking for this when I run out.

Since I started using Neutrogena collagen bank eye gel cream my under skin visually improved. I have brighter and more elastic texture, the dark circles disappeared and my eyes look refreshed and treated with the collagen that it's so important to have when you aged. I see radiance and improved skin tone, small container goes far, you just need tear size of the cream to apply morning and night. Absolutely must have, affordable product that revive your look. Definitely recommend to others.

I loved this product. I am always worried about collagen and making sure my skin looks plump and youthful. I want my eyes to look bright and beautiful! This product has a cooling effect on me when it is first applied. I noticed it makes my skin look AND feel youthful! I would recommend this to anyone!

I tried the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream and my expectations were higher than the results. I may have not tried it long enough but when I did, I wasn't impressed. I dont think it did much for dark circle, fine line, bag issues. I would give it another try but I wont be running to the store for it.
The product lived up to its promise. It was good and easy to use. I would use again if needed. I liked the results and it was easy to clean off afterwards.

Thank you to, Home Tester Club and Neutrogena for the opportunity to try, Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream, for free!! It was an incredible experience. It is day eight and I can see such a difference in the puffiness and the dark circles are hardly noticeable. My skin feels so much more healthy!! It is so light and didn't leave a greasy film. I was able to use my makeup like normal!! It's a really great eye cream that I would highly recommend trying!

I was amazed with this product. A little goes a very very long way. I love to hydrate my skin 2 times a day after I cleanse it, and this is the first product that goes on my face. I don't like to use a lot of makeup (I stay away from foundation) however I do use concealer on my dark circles under my eyes. After using this product for about 2-3 weeks I noticed that I wasn't using much concealer (I actually noticed this morning that I couldn't tell WHERE I just put my concealer! This product is great and I feel like I could incorporate this into my routine.

I have been using this eye cream for around four weeks. I found it to be very hydrating and refreshing. It has a lightweight gel texture that is non greasy and absorbs easily. I have noticed subtle improvements in puffiness around my eyes. I hope to see more with continued use. This is definitely a great eye cream!

I received this Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream by Neutrogena. A little goes along way with this eye cream! It goes on easily absorbs perfectly and works effortlessly. This is non scented and does not leave any oily or gross residue. My fine lines and wrinkles at drastically disappeared while using this!

The Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream is a nice cream, it goes on smooth and feels really nice on my eyes. I think the collagen is helping to smooth out some of my fine lines around my eyes. I would definitely recommend!

Thru HomeTester Club tried the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream) that's infused with collagen, oat and cranberry fruit extract. It has helped diminished fine lines of aging, slightly difused dark circles around my eyes. Had been using it for 2 weeks with no significant improvement, I use it during the day and at night. Maybe need more time to see results.

I love the way it feels going on. very smooth & absorbs quickly. It hydrates the skin to help to smooth out lines & reduce puffiness. I couldn't really tell if it reduced dark circles, since I don't have have a problem with dark circles. All in all, I like it & will continue to use it.

I recieved Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream to test from Home Tester Club. I've been using this eyes cream for over a week and it to my 45 year old eyes and made them look 40! J/k. My black undereye circles have turned a barely noticeable brown color. My fine lines are 90% less noticeable. To my surprise immediately after use the puffiness is completely gone. This may just be the last eye cream I ever use. Try it! No regrets.

I was very lucky to try a new product from Neutrogena. The texture of the cream is very light, there is no heaviness on the eyes, no stickiness, and it absorbs quickly. There is no smell at all, which is fine with me, but I prefer products with a slight fragrance. I think the product is doing its job!

I was very interested in trying this eye cream. I am 39 and it is essential to use quality products in your skin care. My overall experience with this cream is good. When I applied it for the first time, I had warm sensations around one eye, but no irritation. I guess it was just working. And after using it, the skin under my eyes looks fuller, not dry and moisturized. I'll keep using it - I believe that after using it for a few months, that area should look even better.

The Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream is a high quality cream that gets the job done. It leaves the area around my eyes, firm and tight and I feel makes me look younger. I highly recommend this eye cream to my family.
I love the texture of this product. I could feel something working its magic when I put it on! No burning or irritation occurred so I was pleased. When my sample runs out I will be purchasing!

I don't have any deep set wrinkles around my eyes but do have fine lines and occasional dark circles. I was hoping this eye cream would help diminish some of that. The cream itself is smooth and silky. It has a rich, light texture that is easy to apply. You don't need to use a lot to cover the entire eye area. This product is unscented. No strong fragrances which is ideal since it is being applied so close to your eyes. I didn't experience any redness, burning or other side effects when using this product. It seemed a lot gentler than anything that is retinol based. After using this product for a few weeks, I have definitely noticed some results. My undereye area looks brighter and the dark circles have diminished slightly - enough to be noticeable. I can't say that I noticed a reduction of my fine lines just yet but I am still pleased with the results that I have seen. I don't look so "Fester Addams-ish" now which is a good thing. :)

avis.titre: Excellent - I Use It Every Day
avis.texte: I'm loving this product. A little bit goes a long way. It goes on very nicely, it's smooth and absorbs very well. It's not greasy and doesn't have any harsh smell. There is a little tingling sensation when first applied and I notice tightening around my eyes. They feel softer and more hydrated. I highly recommend this product. Great value for the money!

I was alittle skeptical with thks product but I gave it a try anyway because I need some for the bags under my eyes and it definitely worked out great!! Feels amazing ajd smells great!! Def could see a difderence in using it for a few days!! Would definitely recommend this to anybody to try out!!
I love this product. I can see the results. So if u have wrinkles or puff eyes try this stuff. I would definitely recommend it so u need to go out an get it to try it for urself .

avis.titre: My wrinkles are too advanced for this pr
avis.texte: Product went on smoothly. Feels good on my face but, unfortunately my wrinkles are far too advanced for this product. There is no scent, which I like and I always trust the products that come with the Neutrogena product line.

This is fabulous! It is an easy application, and soaks into my skin wonderfully. This isn't greasy and doesn't leave any heavy residue on my skin. This leaves the skin under my eyes bright and refreshed. If totally recommend this!
I recieved this product as a free trial. Ive been using this for nearly two weeks now and I've already started seeing positive results.

I used this product twice a day, in the morning under my makeup and also at night before bed. I noticed less puffyness under my eyes. So I feel with continued use I could see more significant results so I would consider adding this product to my daily routine.
Is a great product I noticed a big change in the look and feel of my skin within two days. I highly recommend this product. It's a wonderful product.

So I reach out about this to customer service and it wasn't very helpful and I also tried clicking that I haven't gotten my product in yet and my review survey keeps popping up and I don't want to to mess up my account. While I do know I love Neutrogena brand and I was SO excited to test this eye cream out I'm super disappointed I didn't get the product and I know others can't be sent so I can't really leave a review about the item just wanted to do my survey so my account didn't get messed up.

I use a Neutrogena makeup remover and have always been curious about their creams. I was not disappointed with their collagen eye cream. It's a thick see through eye cream that just feels smooth and luxurious. I was afraid that it will leave that sticky layer because it was so thick, but it actually absorbed very quickly and never left extra residue like other eye creams do. I would definitely use it all summer and buy it again. It feels like it replenishes all the moisture that I lose with being in the sun all day. My wrinkles seem to be getting less deep and that's only after a few weeks of using it. Excited to see how much it helps my wrinkles in the long run!

This is a great eye cream. I like that I can put it on and it's moisturizing under my eyes. My make up applies very well on top of this cream. I also feel like during the summer. It's just moisturizing enough without clogging the pores.

I could easily say this is comparable to other popular eye creams with a bigger price tag but Neutrogena is good for making effective products affordable and this is why I often end up stocking them. It's a nice cool non-sticky cream with a pleasant fragrance, a bit perfumey but not overly so. It goes on smoothly and feels a little thick but absorbs cleanly with no residue. I had no eye irritation even when I had a bit too much sun and many products can be punishing for damaged skin. This one definitely isn't. A little goes a very long way so this little tub barely looks touched even after using it twice daily for over a week. Yet another Neutrogena product I'm keeping in the lineup. I recommend giving this a try. The skin around my eyes does feel firmer and looks a bit less puffy than when I started. Buy it before you need it and it will definitely help maintain youthful skin.

avis.titre: A Great Solution For Dark Circles & Bags
avis.texte: I received this product to test out for a week and give an honest review. From the first use, I noticed a little less puffiness and the discoloration I've had in the under eye area as long as I can remember(thanks genetics) instantly appeared a little lighter. After a week of using this both AM and PM, the difference in my under eye area is great! I wake up with less than half of the puffiness I used to, and most of that I'm sure is because of my allergies. I also have very little discoloration anymore. Instead of the very dark purple, almost black looking, I'm used to trying to conceal, I now have a very light pinkish hue. The best part is, if I don't have the time, or just don't feel up to, using a special under eye color corrector or concealer, I dont look like a raccoon any longer. I highly recommend this to anyone that is looking for an under eye miracle in a jar. I will definitely be purchasing so I can continue using it.

This Neutrogena product does not leave my eye area sticky or tacky. It was easy to apply and absorbed into my skin fairly quickly and easily. Left my skin feeling hydrated and helped with my "tired eyes" look.

This Neutrogena eye cream is amazing! I have been using this product under my eyes for more than a week and I can already see results. My circles under my eyes are getting better. My eyes are looking brighter and it feels lovely on my skin. I definitely recommend this product!
I really love the gel consistency of this product and it really hydrated under my eyes. The skin looks more plump and less papery looking. So I'm gonna say it's working pretty well.

The gel is smooth, really nice feeling. A little bit goes a long way, but the container it comes in could be a bit bigger. The price is affordable and the gel is effective for what it is intended for. Make sure you wash your hands before applying and wash off any other creams or makeup before applying. The little jar it comes in makes it look fancy. I smell no overpowering scent and this eye gel is cool to the touch, it feels good on my skin.

I've used this daily for 8 days now. I think you need more time to get optimal results but so far I really like the product. It's thick but blends in so nice. The jar is small but will last so long. I wouldn't let the piece deter you. It's gonna go a really long way. I've barely made a dent in it. At 40 anything I can do to help my face I'm fully in!
This eye cream is really great. I love the amount of collagen in it. I feel it helps with wrinkles and aging and fine lines as well as puffiness.

I've never really tried eye creams before but I have to say I will definitely continue to use this one!! I can definitely see the difference in my dark circles and dryness under my eyes in only a matter of days! 10/10 I definitely recommend! :)

I have been using this and I like that it does brighten the undereye area, however so far in the past several days it has not helped my undereye bags, that I can see, but as I said it has brightened the area and I do like that.

I've been using the Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream for a few days now, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. As someone who struggles with early signs of aging and persistent dark circles, this product has made a noticeable difference. The texture is lightweight and cooling, which makes it feel soothing the moment you apply it—especially helpful for tired or puffy under-eyes. Within the first week, I saw a reduction in puffiness, particularly in the mornings. The gel absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any greasy residue, making it perfect under makeup or as part of a nighttime. Thanks neutrogena
I fell in love with this the first time I used it. It feels great is lightweight and works wonders. I will be adding this to my daily face regimen.

I received this product, and I have to say, it doesn't take much to see quick results! Even though the jar I received was small, you don't need a lot of the product! It feels very cooling, smooth texture and absorbs quickly, without feeling greasy or heavy! My skin loves this stuff! I would definitely purchase this!
After using this Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream for the last 2 weeks or so, I have noticed a significant difference in the appearance of dark circles and puffiness around my eyes!

I have always had tired, puffy under eyes, so age isn't doing me any favors! I like Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Cream because it contains peptides and niacinamide to work on collagen, dark circles, and puffiness. It feels moisturizing and soothing right away, but the best part is that you're taking a healthy step for your future. For the price and ingredients I think this is an excellent choice for anyone looking to add an eye cream to their routine.

I'm impressed with the results. The cream absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving no greasy residue behind. The eye area looks smoother and fine lines appear less noticeable. helps with dark circles and puffiness. I noticed a big difference in my crows feet.

avis.titre: An eye cream that actually works!
avis.texte: I'm always looking for new skincare products especially eye creams. This Neutrogena Collagen Bank Reviving Eye Gel Cream works great. I wanted to use it for at least 2 weeks before giving my honest review. I love how lightweight and luxurious it feels on the skin. It absorbs well and doesn't leave behind any stickiness or tackiness. It moisturizes and refreshes instantly. So far it has lived up to it's claims. I have seen a difference with puffiness, dark circles and texture. I have seen a slight difference in the fine lines around my eyes. They aren't as prominent. I also love how it's fragrance free, safe for sensitive skin, gentle enough for daily use and layers well under makeup. This eye cream is definitely a great alternative to retinol especially if you have sensitive skin. Overall I love everything about this eye cream. It is a little pricey but skincare is an investment and well worth it. I highly recommend and would purchase again.
I really liked this product. I noticed a visibly difference in my puffy eye bags within 2 days of using it. I'm on day 3 now. I can update this review after I'm finished with the tedt.

I love this eye cream. I have dry skin including my eyes and this gave me supple skin around my eyes and is very hydrating. I have seen a difference in my eyes with my puffiness and dark eye circles. I have recommended this product to my friends and family.
